rat 5, colonist 3, muffalo 2 at ref damage; 6 (cap), 5, 4 at twice; thrumbo 240 kg spared at 150, thrown 1 then 3 at 250; power off ratio 1

seed 20261125; 0 <= cells <= cap; 0 when force <= 0, dist >= radius or strength 0; never more for heavier, farther, weaker, lower strength or lower cap; wild 1.6 >= plain, capped, wild 1 = plain. all hold
wild goods throw = round(1.6 x the unrounded person throw), uncapped here, at 29 distances x 4 masses

a straight hit flips the struck axis; water reflects nothing; seed 11, 4878 random hits: no reflected first step re-enters the solid cell

creature limit 150 weighs living pawns only (heavier than = spared); goods limit 75 weighs goods and corpses only; a rim throw under one cell is 0

projectile -> weapon -> damage type, first wins whole (a 0 wins); untuned harmful at the shipped percent, harmless 0; own cap, cap scale, exact gas cap, impact factor 0 at walls, pawns and bruises, the mass override; the shared settings unchanged

fire force 0.5 throws within a cell of half the bomb's throw at 25 distances; the switch zeroes fire only on the damage type's own patch; INFO: at the calibration distance whole cells give fire 1 vs bomb 3
the extra drain is force x debit x loss, never negative
no second throw until max(landing, stun end) + the shipped 120-tick window; 0 = chains allowed
a 1x1 container at or under 250 kg flies the item throw at its whole mass (never farther than its own goods loose, never past the cap); over it, or bigger than 1x1, 0 (a jolt)
seed 5: a stack of 10 kg or more hits for 2..5 blunt and a 30-tick stagger; lighter, corpses, gas-thrown or switched off pass
a thrown landing breaks a cover, a gas burst and a container never do; a shove enters only empty open ground; a pawn on a pit cell blocks a thrown pawn

seed 13: a repeat (explosion, thing) inside the window is refused, other pairs pass, entries live at least a window and are gone at two

seed 17: the drawn jolt never exceeds its amplitude and is 0 outside its ticks
